text:
I identified the items on a square plate of roughly 24 cm and estimated each portion by eye.

| Item | Mass (g) | Energy (kcal) |
|---|---|---|
| Sliced roast beef | 70 | 140 |
| Roasted potatoes and purple potatoes | 60 | 90 |
| Chicken pieces | 80 | 160 |
| Broccoli | 50 | 20 |
| Pizza slice | 50 | 140 |
| Caesar salad with dressing | 90 | 120 |

These add up to about 670 kcal and 400 g. I rounded the total to about 650 kcal.
